layout: Clean tax invoice with two line items at the same rate, a printed total quantity, a due date printed beside 'Net 45 days', and the discount and interest in a numbered terms list.
notes: Second demo bill, longer terms than the first: 1.5% discount within 15 days, net 45 days. The late charge is printed per YEAR (18% per annum). The one conversion the reader may do is yearly to monthly (divide by 12), so lateFeePercentPerMonth is 1.5 and the evidence is the note 'Printed as 18% per annum, converted to 1.5% per month'.
